params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repo='C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods-work-canonical'; if (!(Test-Path $repo)) { Write-Output 'REPO_MISSING'; Get-ChildItem 'C:\Users\Xxkan' -Directory -Filter '*mhw*' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName; exit 2 }; Write-Output '===ROOT==='; git -C $repo rev-parse --show-toplevel; Write-Output '===FETCH==='; git -C $repo fetch --all --prune; Write-Output '===STATUS==='; git -C $repo status --short --branch; Write-Output '===BRANCH==='; git -C $repo branch --show-current; Write-Output '===REMOTES==='; git -C $repo remote -v; Write-Output '===SHAS==='; Write-Output ('HEAD=' + (git -C $repo rev-parse HEAD)); Write-Output ('LOCAL_MAIN=' + (git -C $repo rev-parse main)); Write-Output ('ORIGIN_MAIN=' + (git -C $repo rev-parse origin/main)); Write-Output '===DIVERGENCE main...origin/main==='; git -C $repo rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main; Write-Output '===STASH==='; git -C $repo stash list; Write-Output '===WORKTREES==='; git -C $repo worktree list --porcelain; Write-Output '===BRANCHES==='; git -C $repo branch -vv --all; Write-Output '===RECENT LOCAL/REMOTE SUPPORT REFS==='; git -C $repo for-each-ref --sort=-committerdate --format='%(committerdate:iso-strict)|%(refname:short)|%(objectname:short)|%(subject)' refs/heads refs/remotes/origin | Select-Object -First 120
